title: Empire State Manufacturing Survey, December 2026 — the first Fed-funded manufacturing read after the 12-11 funding cliff, 8:30 a.m. ET
source: EST: newyorkfed.org/survey/empire/empiresurvey_overview — the New York Fed's own overview page, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 131,466 bytes) by the empire-state-mfg-2026-09-15 initial research. Its 2026 release grid enumerates DEC 15 alongside SEP 15, OCT 15 and NOV 16, above the page's own note 'Released at or shortly after 8:30 a.m.' Independently reproduced by the survey's published rule (the 15th, rolled forward off weekends): 2026-12-15 is a Tuesday, so no roll applies. Filed estimate on the two standing counts every sibling regional-survey entry documents: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for a regional Reserve Bank's own survey schedule (FED: covers the federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar only), and this lane does not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: PROPOSED (not canonical) by the empire-state-mfg-2026-09-15 initial-research adjacency sweep on 2026-09-09. Filed for a measured reason rather than for series completeness, and deliberately NOT filed for the November 16 edition, which was considered and declined in the same sweep. The reason is the funding cliff. government-funding-deadline-2026-12-11 and cr-expiry-2026-12-11 are both tracked at high impact; philly-fed-mfg-2026-09-17's quarter-horizon call already names 12-11 as 'the one branch on which a Fed-funded regional survey becomes the important number of its morning', pointing at Philly's 12-17 edition six days past the cliff. This entry is the same branch two days EARLIER and four days past the cliff: Empire is the first regional Federal Reserve manufacturing survey of each month, it is funded outside the appropriations process, and it prints 2026-12-15. The 12-15 morning makes the point concretely — its 8:30 slot is shared with ppi-2026-12-15 (medium, confirmed BLS:), which is exactly the release a lapse in appropriations suspends. On the shutdown branch Empire's December print is the only manufacturing datum of its morning and the first after the cliff; on the no-shutdown branch it is ordinary context beside a PPI that prints normally. Either way it is the earlier and therefore the more informative of the pair's two post-cliff editions. Impact LOW and symbols [] on the same grounds as every sibling regional-survey entry: a single-state qualitative diffusion index, no house playbook keyed to regional surveys, and no tracked name carrying a New York district manufacturing channel. This is a PROPOSAL and an ESTIMATE — it widens caution, licenses nothing, and whoever writes the canonical empire-state-mfg-2026-12-15.json owns re-verifying the date and re-testing whether the 12-11 branch is still open by then.
